page_or_component: Departments page: form field(s), likely the site search box
wcag_reference: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships; 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions; 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value
evidence: Lighthouse report (lighthouse-report-trivandrum.pdf, mobile emulation, 25 Oct 2026) p.3, Accessibility > Names and labels: 'Form elements do not have associated labels' (failed). Confirm the exact element by expanding this audit in DevTools.
user_impact: Screen reader users hear an unnamed edit field and cannot tell what to type; voice-control users cannot target it by name.
recommended_fix: Add a visible <label for> or aria-label to every input (e.g. 'Search departments'); re-run Lighthouse to confirm the audit passes.

evidence: Lighthouse report (lighthouse-report-trivandrum.pdf, mobile emulation, 25 Oct 2026) p.3, Accessibility > Tables and lists: 'Lists do not contain only <li> elements and script supporting elements' (failed). Page itself shows a bulleted department list starting with 'Home'.
user_impact: Screen readers may announce wrong item counts or skip list content, making the long department list harder to navigate.
recommended_fix: Make <ul>/<ol> contain only <li> children (wrap stray elements inside <li>); validate with Lighthouse and the W3C validator.

wcag_reference: No direct WCAG criterion (usability for low-bandwidth users; architecture)
evidence: Lighthouse report (lighthouse-report-trivandrum.pdf, mobile emulation, 25 Oct 2026) p.2: FCP 3.7 s, LCP 6.4 s, Speed Index 3.7 s; 'Render-blocking requests' est. savings 2,160 ms; Performance score 69 on slow 4G.
user_impact: Citizens on slow mobile networks wait several seconds for any content, and assistive tech cannot start reading until the page renders.
recommended_fix: Defer or inline critical CSS, load non-critical scripts with defer/async, preload the LCP hero image and use font-display: swap.

evidence: Lighthouse report (lighthouse-report-trivandrum.pdf, mobile emulation, 25 Oct 2026) p.2-3: 'Use efficient cache lifetimes' est. savings 1,520 KiB; 'Improve image delivery' 364 KiB; 'Reduce unused CSS' 185 KiB; 'Minify CSS' 22 KiB; 'Minify JavaScript' 17 KiB.
user_impact: Heavy, uncached assets are re-downloaded on every visit, costing data and time for users on limited plans or older phones.
recommended_fix: Set long Cache-Control lifetimes with hashed filenames, serve resized WebP/AVIF images, purge unused theme CSS, and minify CSS/JS in the build.

wcag_reference: 4.1.1 Parsing / robustness (best practice); no direct WCAG criterion
evidence: Lighthouse report (lighthouse-report-trivandrum.pdf, mobile emulation, 25 Oct 2026) p.4, Best Practices (73): 'Browser errors were logged to the console' (failed), 'Uses deprecated APIs: 1 warning found' (failed), 'Displays images with incorrect aspect ratio' (failed).
user_impact: Script errors can silently break interactive features such as menus for keyboard and screen reader users; distorted images reduce clarity.
recommended_fix: Fix the logged console errors, replace the deprecated API, and set correct width/height or aspect-ratio on images; add an error-free console as a CI check.
